enemy.bandit_fighter.name: Bandit Fighter
enemy.bandit_fighter.scan: A seasoned cutthroat in heavy gear. Unleashes triple strikes and salvos that threaten paralysis.
enemy.bandit_scout.name: Bandit Scout
enemy.bandit_scout.scan: A lightly armored bandit scout. Weak in melee, relying mainly on basic attacks.
enemy.bandit_sorcerer.name: Bandit Sorcerer
enemy.bandit_sorcerer.scan: A bandit mage aiding his allies through trickery. Deploys a smoke screen that drastically reduces accuracy.
enemy.bandit_tracker.name: Bandit Tracker
enemy.bandit_tracker.scan: A vigilant tracker hunting from the shadows. Can knock heroes down and inflict dangerous stuns.
enemy.bat_fur.name: Furry Bat
enemy.bat_fur.scan: A predatory bat covered in thick fur. Has no special techniques, but attacks without hesitation.
enemy.bat_small.name: Small Bat
enemy.bat_small.scan: A skittish cave pest. Has low health, but can be troublesome in larger swarms.
enemy.elf_base.name: Elf
enemy.elf_base.scan: A young woodland warden. Agile, but lacking advanced combat training.
enemy.elf_druid.name: Elf Druid
enemy.elf_druid.scan: A druid wielding forest magic. Strikes with a toxic glare that immediately poisons the hero.
enemy.elf_hunter.name: Elf Hunter
enemy.elf_hunter.scan: A skilled wilderness hunter. Aims for weak spots to knock down and stun targets.
enemy.elf_ranger.name: Elf Ranger
enemy.elf_ranger.scan: An elite scout of the wild. Unleashes a rapid flurry of three blows and can stun targets.
enemy.fungus_heavy.name: Heavy Spore
enemy.fungus_heavy.scan: A massive spore colossus. Strikes in volleys and breathes a toxic cloud of decay.
enemy.fungus_immature.name: Immature Spore
enemy.fungus_immature.scan: A small, newly sprouted subterranean mushroom. Fragile and easily eliminated.
enemy.fungus_long.name: Tall Spore
enemy.fungus_long.scan: A slender mushroom with a springy stem. Delivers flurries of blows that risk paralysis.
enemy.fungus_old.name: Ancient Spore
enemy.fungus_old.scan: An ancient subterranean lord. Triggers blast waves across the party, whirls blades, and poisons with decay.
enemy.mummy_base.name: Mummy
enemy.mummy_base.scan: An animated corpse wrapped in decayed bandages. A slow tomb relic with low durability.
enemy.mummy_mage.name: Mummy Mage
enemy.mummy_mage.scan: An ancient tomb priest. Casts a hypnotic glare that leaves heroes confused.
enemy.mummy_rogue.name: Mummy Rogue
enemy.mummy_rogue.scan: A grave robber cursed in death. Strikes with surprising momentum to knock down and stun.
enemy.mummy_warrior.name: Mummy Warrior
enemy.mummy_warrior.scan: A guardian of pharaonic crypts. Strikes three times and unleashes a paralyzing barrage.
enemy.orc_base.name: Orc
enemy.orc_base.scan: A young orc fighter. Compensates for lack of finesse with raw strength, but is easily defeated.
enemy.orc_rogue.name: Orc Rogue
enemy.orc_rogue.scan: An unusually agile orc fighting dirty. Leaps in to attack, knocking down and stunning the target.
enemy.orc_shaman.name: Orc Shaman
enemy.orc_shaman.scan: A practitioner of dark clan rituals. Casts a toxic glare that instantly poisons the target.
enemy.orc_warrior.name: Orc Warrior
enemy.orc_warrior.scan: A ruthless clan veteran. Deluges foes with triple strikes and launches paralyzing salvos.
enemy.rat_base.name: Rat
enemy.rat_base.scan: A common sewer rodent. Frail, but swift and vicious.
enemy.rat_mage.name: Rat Mage
enemy.rat_mage.scan: A rodent warped by sewer magic. Radiates a venomous gaze that guarantees poisoning.
enemy.rat_rogue.name: Rat Rogue
enemy.rat_rogue.scan: A gutter shadow ambushing from behind. Able to knock heroes down and inflict a stun.
enemy.rat_warrior.name: Rat Warrior
enemy.rat_warrior.scan: A giant ratman clad in scrap armor. Deals triple slashes and paralyzing volleys.
enemy.rat_king.name: Rat King
enemy.rat_king.scan: Lord of the sewers in a crown of rust. Slashes thrice, stuns with heavy blows, poisons with a screech and heals in the dark.
enemy.royal_archer.name: Royal Archer
enemy.royal_archer.scan: A trained castle marksman. Aims precision shots at legs to knock down and stun targets.
enemy.royal_knight.name: Royal Knight
enemy.royal_knight.scan: An elite steel-clad crown defender. Strikes with a three-hit sword flurry and a paralyzing volley.
enemy.royal_priest.name: Royal Priest
enemy.royal_priest.scan: A court cleric harboring dark powers. Regenerates vitality through dark energy.
enemy.royal_soldier.name: Royal Soldier
enemy.royal_soldier.scan: A rank-and-file guardsman on watch. Disciplined, but poses little threat alone.
enemy.scholar_cataloguer.name: Cataloguer
enemy.scholar_cataloguer.scan: An archivist of the great library. Appears completely lost in combat and is easily neutralized.
enemy.scholar_censor.name: Censor
enemy.scholar_censor.scan: A guardian of secrets and censorship. Blinds opponents with dense smoke, preventing accurate attacks.
enemy.scholar_director.name: Director
enemy.scholar_director.scan: Director of forbidden archives. Terrifies the party with ghostly howls and shocks with silencing bolts.
enemy.scholar_researcher.name: Researcher
enemy.scholar_researcher.scan: A scholar studying forgotten manuscripts. Little threat without assistants.
enemy.skeleton_base.name: Skeleton
enemy.skeleton_base.scan: Brittle bones bound by necromancy. Shatters under a few well-placed blows.
enemy.skeleton_mage.name: Skeleton Mage
enemy.skeleton_mage.scan: An undead adept of black magic. Glances with venomous eyes, ensuring poisoning.
enemy.skeleton_rogue.name: Skeleton Rogue
enemy.skeleton_rogue.scan: A bony assassin ambushing from shadows. Knocks targets off balance, inflicting a stun.
enemy.skeleton_warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
enemy.skeleton_warrior.scan: An armored skeleton of war. Relentlessly cuts with triple strikes and paralyzing blows.
enemy.statue_feminine.name: Feminine Statue
enemy.statue_feminine.scan: An animated stone sculpture. Heavy and slow, striking only with basic attacks.
enemy.statue_masculine.name: Masculine Statue
enemy.statue_masculine.scan: A marble monument set in motion. Tough, yet devoid of advanced techniques.
enemy.statue_medusa.name: Medusa
enemy.statue_medusa.scan: A mythical stone monster. Terrifies the party with sinister howls and silences with phantom shocks.
enemy.statue_old.name: Elder Statue
enemy.statue_old.scan: An old, cracked runic statue. Its heavy stone blows carry a risk of paralysis.
enemy.stone_base.name: Pebbleling
enemy.stone_base.scan: A primitive creature of rock and moss. Slow and vulnerable to shattering.
enemy.stone_broken.name: Broken Pebbleling
enemy.stone_broken.scan: A damaged rock fragment barely holding shape. Crumbles almost instantly.
enemy.stone_golem.name: Stone Golem
enemy.stone_golem.scan: A massive construct of solid rock. Crushes with triple blows and paralyzes with heavy volleys.
enemy.stone_lava.name: Lava Pebbleling
enemy.stone_lava.scan: A magma-burning rock colossus. Attacks with triple momentum and paralyzes with scalding strikes.
enemy.zombie_banshee.name: Banshee
enemy.zombie_banshee.scan: A wailing undead phantom. Releases a shroud of dark smoke that completely blinds the target.
enemy.zombie_base.name: Zombie
enemy.zombie_base.scan: A shambling undead rotting in the depths. Easily outmaneuvered with no special attacks.
enemy.zombie_muscle.name: Zombie Brute
enemy.zombie_muscle.scan: A mutated brute of superhuman strength. Unleashes triple strikes and a paralyzing volley.
enemy.zombie_overweight.name: Bloated Zombie
enemy.zombie_overweight.scan: A lumbering, bloated cadaver. Its massed blows can paralyze the target.

item.aegis_shield.name: Aegis Shield
item.antidote.name: Antidote
item.apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
item.cloth_cap.name: Cloth Cap
item.crown_of_clarity.desc: A mystical diadem protecting mind and body from the lethal power of the fog.
item.crown_of_clarity.name: Crown of Clarity

item.guard_spear.desc: A long spear with an iron tip.
item.guard_spear.name: Guard Spear
item.hunter_bow.name: Hunter's Bow
item.iron_buckler.desc: A round iron shield providing reliable protection against blows.
item.iron_buckler.name: Iron Buckler
item.iron_chainmail.desc: Interlinked iron rings providing solid torso protection.
item.iron_chainmail.name: Iron Chainmail
item.iron_helmet.desc: A heavy soldier's helmet guarding against blows to the head.
item.iron_helmet.name: Iron Helmet
item.iron_sword.desc: A solid weapon forged of iron, resting comfortably in hand.
item.iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
item.key_tier1.desc: Bronze key: opens tier 1 chests. Consumed on use.
item.key_tier1.name: Bronze Key
item.key_tier2.desc: Silver key: opens tier 1–2 chests. Consumed on use.
item.key_tier2.name: Silver Key
item.key_tier3.desc: Blue key: opens tier 1–3 chests. Consumed on use.
item.key_tier3.name: Sapphire Key
item.knight_broadsword.desc: A finely balanced sword wielded by the elite castle guard.
item.knight_broadsword.name: Knight's Broadsword
item.knight_plate_armor.desc: Heavy steel armor worn by defenders of the castle walls.
item.knight_plate_armor.name: Plate Armor
item.knight_shield.desc: A hardened shield bearing the kingdom's crest, withstanding powerful strikes.
item.knight_shield.name: Royal Guard Shield
item.knight_visored_helm.desc: An elaborately crafted knight's helm providing excellent face and head protection.
item.knight_visored_helm.name: Visored Helm
item.leather_hood.desc: A durable hardened-leather hood protecting the head from impacts.
item.leather_hood.name: Leather Hood
item.lockpick.desc: Opens a locked chest by solving a quiz (higher tier chests are harder). May break on failure.
item.lockpick.name: Lockpick
item.lucky_charm.desc: A small talisman that brings reassurance.
item.lucky_charm.name: Lucky Charm
item.mist_blade_1.desc: A dull blade found in a forgotten crypt. The blacksmith says it is only the beginning.
item.mist_blade_1.name: Mist Blade
item.mist_blade_2.desc: A reforged blade — a silvery haze swirls in the steel.
item.mist_blade_2.name: Mist Blade II
item.mist_blade_3.desc: Runes on the blade glow as the mist thickens around it.
item.mist_blade_3.name: Mist Blade III
item.mist_blade_4.desc: The blade at full power: it cuts the mist and what hides within it.
item.mist_blade_4.name: Mist Blade IV

item.potion_1l.name: Great Potion
item.potion_1m.name: Large Potion

item.priest_mace.desc: An iron-shod mace for melee combat.
item.priest_mace.name: Priest's Mace
item.reinforced_tunic.desc: A thick tunic reinforced with leather straps and metal studs.
item.reinforced_tunic.name: Reinforced Tunic
item.runic_claymore.desc: An ancient sword engraved with glowing runes that dispel dark magic.
item.runic_claymore.name: Runic Claymore
item.scout_dagger.desc: A lightweight dagger made for swift strikes.
item.scout_dagger.name: Scout's Dagger
item.shadowbane_sword.desc: A legendary blade forged from pure light essence, banishing the deepest dark.
item.shadowbane_sword.name: Shadowbane Sword
item.steel_blade.desc: A heavy, tempered blade capable of cleaving thick armor.
item.steel_blade.name: Steel Cleaver
item.steel_kite_shield.desc: A massive infantry shield capable of deflecting the heaviest impacts.
item.steel_kite_shield.name: Steel Kite Shield
item.training_sword.desc: A simple sword for a novice hero.
item.training_sword.name: Training Sword
item.universal_key.desc: Golden key: instantly opens chests of any tier (1–4). Consumed on use.
item.universal_key.name: Skeleton Key
item.warden_cuirass.desc: Armor infused with ancient protective magic, impenetrable to darkness.
item.warden_cuirass.name: Warden's Cuirass
item.woodcutter_axe.desc: A heavy axe with a broad blade.
item.woodcutter_axe.name: Woodcutter's Axe
item.wooden_shield.desc: A light shield, but better than nothing.
item.wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield

npc.armorer.greeting_1: A shield and a good helmet have saved more heads than the finest sword.
npc.armorer.name: Kastor
npc.blacksmith.greeting_1: Blades, axes, spears. I can't recall how to forge better steel… yet.
npc.blacksmith.name: Brann
npc.blacksmith.recall_1: Wait… something is coming back to me. I remember how to temper steel now! Come by my forge — I have better blades for you.
npc.companion.done: You kept your word. I'm coming with you!
npc.companion.intro_1: Hey, wanderer. This mist took my memories — but not my wits.
npc.companion.intro_2: Answer {count} questions correctly, and I'll believe it's worth joining you.
npc.inn.offer: A night's rest costs {price} D (you have {gold} D). Will you stay?
npc.inn.rested: The party is rested. HP and SP restored.
npc.innkeeper.greeting_1: Tired? You'll sleep here like at your mother's.
npc.innkeeper.name: Greta
npc.innkeeper.talk_1: The mist grows thicker every day. People forget their neighbours' names.
npc.shopkeeper.greeting_1: Herbs, potions, antidotes — everything that keeps you alive.
npc.shopkeeper.name: Fenna
npc.teacher.greeting_1: I'll teach you the forms. Not my personal technique — everyone hones that alone.
npc.teacher.name: Corvus
npc.villager.name: Lina
npc.villager.talk_1: Sometimes I think I remember birds singing… but the Mist takes everything.
npc.villager.talk_2: Take care of yourself. I heard someone saw a light in the sewers under the town.

skill.aerial_strike.desc: Calls down a devastating meteor from the heavens, dealing massive physical and magical damage to an enemy.
skill.aerial_strike.name: Meteor Strike
skill.arc_spark.desc: Hurls a spark of pure mana at an enemy. Magic damage (MAT against MDF).
skill.arc_spark.name: Arc Spark
skill.backstab.desc: A swift surprise strike (×1.4). Sleeping enemies take double damage.
skill.backstab.name: Backstab
skill.battering_dash.desc: The enemy charges violently into a hero, dealing 1.5× normal damage.
skill.battering_dash.log: {enemy} rams the target with great force!
skill.battering_dash.name: Battering Dash
skill.blinding_smoke.desc: The enemy shrouds a hero in smoke, with a 100% chance to inflict blind.
skill.blinding_smoke.log: {enemy} shrouds the battlefield in thick smoke!
skill.blinding_smoke.name: Smoke Lens
skill.burst_swarm.desc: The enemy fires a barrage of 4 flashes at random heroes, with a 25% chance to inflict blind per hit.
skill.burst_swarm.log: {enemy} detonates a series of charges with a deafening blast!
skill.burst_swarm.name: Flash Barrage
skill.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning leaps between enemies, striking random targets 3 times (magic damage ×0.9), with a 15% chance to paralyze on each hit.
skill.chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
skill.coin_barrage.desc: Hurls a barrage of sharp daggers at random enemies, striking 3 times in total.
skill.coin_barrage.name: Dagger Barrage
skill.crushing_blow.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a risky blow dealing 25,000 fixed damage, with a 16% chance to hit.
skill.crushing_blow.name: Crushing Blow
skill.dark_regen.desc: The enemy channels dark energy, restoring 25% of its max HP.
skill.dark_regen.log: {enemy} absorbs dark energy and recovers strength!
skill.dark_regen.name: Dark Mending
skill.death_enrage.desc: Enters a destructive battle frenzy, unleashing a deadly series of 9 strikes on all enemies.
skill.death_enrage.name: Destruction Frenzy
skill.decay_breath.desc: The enemy breathes noxious vapors at a hero, with a 50% chance to inflict poison.
skill.decay_breath.name: Decay Breath
skill.dive_attack.desc: Strikes from the shadows with deadly surprise, dealing 1.5× regular damage.
skill.dive_attack.name: Shadow Strike
skill.dizzying_gaze.desc: The enemy casts a hypnotic glare at a hero, with a 100% chance to inflict confusion.
skill.dizzying_gaze.log: {enemy} casts a hypnotic glare that clouds the senses!
skill.dizzying_gaze.name: Confusion Lens
skill.double_throw.desc: Delivers two lightning-fast dagger thrusts to a single enemy.
skill.double_throw.name: Twin Strike
skill.dual_attack.desc: The enemy strikes a hero twice in rapid succession.
skill.dual_attack.name: Dual Attack
skill.final_strike.desc: Channels all momentum into a single devastating blow (ATK × 8), shattering the equipped sword.
skill.final_strike.name: Final Blow
skill.fireball.desc: After a moment of focus, launches a fireball dealing heavy magic damage to the target (×1.9).
skill.fireball.name: Fireball
skill.frenzy_charge.desc: The enemy unleashes a furious rush on a hero, delivering a series of 8 strikes.
skill.frenzy_charge.name: Frenzy Rush
skill.hearty_meal.desc: Heals an ally for MAT × 4 HP through fervent prayer. Can also be used from the menu.
skill.hearty_meal.name: Healing Prayer
skill.heavy_strike.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a flurry of 4 blows, with a 25% chance to inflict paralysis.
skill.heavy_strike.log: {enemy} strikes with a tangle of metal limbs!
skill.heavy_strike.name: Shock Flurry
skill.holy_light.desc: Smites an enemy with a beam of holy light. Magic damage (MAT against MDF).
skill.holy_light.name: Holy Light
skill.ice_shard.desc: Pierces an enemy with a shard of ice (magic damage ×1.2), with a 40% chance to slow them (AGI down).
skill.ice_shard.name: Ice Shard
skill.knockdown.desc: The enemy delivers a heavy knockdown blow against a hero, with a 35% chance to stun.
skill.knockdown.name: Knockdown
skill.leap_series.desc: Unleashes a rapid series of 5 swift strikes on an enemy, with a 4% chance to stun per hit.
skill.leap_series.name: Swift Flurry
skill.leczenie.desc: Restores 30% HP to an ally (10% on a wrong quiz answer). Can also be used from the menu.
skill.leczenie.name: Heal
skill.lullaby.desc: Unleashes a barrage of 9 slumbering astral missiles, with a 70% chance to induce sleep with each hit.
skill.lullaby.name: Slumber Missiles
skill.mass_prayer.desc: A shared prayer heals every living ally for MAT × 2.5 HP. Also works in the menu.
skill.mass_prayer.name: Mass Prayer
skill.mocny_atak.desc: Delivers a powerful blow dealing 1.5× regular damage.
skill.mocny_atak.name: Heavy Strike
skill.nurturing_care.desc: Envelops an ally in an aura of sacred light, granting a defense (DEF) boost.
skill.nurturing_care.name: Armor of Faith
skill.onslaught.desc: Unleashes a deadly dance of 6 rapid slashes against a single enemy.
skill.onslaught.name: Blade Dance
skill.phantom_volt.desc: The enemy shocks a hero with spectral energy, with a 40% chance to silence.
skill.phantom_volt.name: Phantom Volt
skill.piercing_shriek.desc: Strikes an enemy with a bolt of caustic venom with a 15% chance to poison. Deals more than double damage (×2.1) to poisoned targets.
skill.piercing_shriek.name: Venom Bolt
skill.poison_vine.desc: The enemy ensnares a hero with a venomous vine, with an 80% chance to inflict poison.
skill.poison_vine.log: {enemy} ensnares you with a poisonous vine!
skill.poison_vine.name: Poison Vine
skill.reckless_blow.desc: An incredibly powerful, risky blow dealing 25,000 to 50,000 fixed damage, but hitting with only an 8% chance.
skill.reckless_blow.name: Reckless Strike
skill.relentless_assault.desc: The enemy assaults a hero with a relentless flurry of 6 strikes.
skill.relentless_assault.log: {enemy} unleashes a series of 6 violent strikes!
skill.relentless_assault.name: Relentless Assault
skill.renewal_circle.desc: Surrounds the whole party with a circle of renewal: each ally recovers some HP every turn (regeneration).
skill.renewal_circle.name: Circle of Renewal
skill.resurrection.desc: Brings a fallen ally back to life with 50% of max HP. Also works in the menu.
skill.resurrection.name: Grace of Return
skill.revive_tonic.desc: Restores a fallen ally to life with 30% max HP through divine grace. Can also be used from the menu.
skill.revive_tonic.name: Resurrection
skill.rousing_tune.desc: Chants an inspiring battle hymn, increasing the attack (ATK) of a chosen ally.
skill.rousing_tune.name: Battle Hymn
skill.scan.desc: Reveals the HP, stats, and description of a chosen enemy. Does not consume a turn.
skill.scan.name: Scan
skill.sea_chant.desc: Places a mystical seal that suppresses magic, silencing a chosen enemy with a 50% chance.
skill.sea_chant.name: Seal of Silence
skill.share_tempo.desc: Bestows the wind's blessing upon the whole party, boosting all allies' agility (AGI).
skill.share_tempo.name: Wind's Blessing
skill.shove.desc: Strikes a vital pressure point with precision, with a 50% chance to inflict paralysis.
skill.shove.name: Paralyzing Strike
skill.smoke_cloud.desc: Releases a thick cloud of smoke at an enemy, with a 50% chance to blind them.
skill.smoke_cloud.name: Smoke Screen
skill.sonic_blast.desc: The enemy blasts the entire party with a sonic shockwave, with a 30% chance to inflict confusion.
skill.sonic_blast.name: Sonic Blast
skill.sound_wave.desc: Unleashes a surge of miasmic magic striking all enemies (50% chance to hit each target), with a 40% chance to poison.
skill.sound_wave.name: Toxic Wave
skill.spook_howl.desc: The enemy emits a terrifying howl at the entire party, with a 60% chance to inflict spooked.
skill.spook_howl.name: Spook Howl
skill.timed_charge.desc: The enemy detonates a powerful explosive wave that damages the entire party.
skill.timed_charge.log: {enemy} hurls a ticking explosive at the enemies!
skill.timed_charge.name: Blast Wave
skill.toxic_gaze.desc: The enemy directs a toxic glare at a hero, with a 100% chance to inflict poison.
skill.toxic_gaze.name: Poison Lens
skill.triple_attack.desc: The enemy attacks a hero with a series of 3 strikes.
skill.triple_attack.log: {enemy} strikes with a series of three blows!
skill.triple_attack.name: Triple Attack
skill.venom_blade.desc: A strike with a venom-coated dagger, with a 60% chance to poison. Requires a dagger.
skill.venom_blade.name: Venom Blade
skill.venom_screech.desc: The enemy emits an ear-splitting screech at a hero, with a 40% chance to inflict poison.
skill.venom_screech.name: Venom Screech
skill.whirling_slash.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a series of 3 whirling slashes.
skill.whirling_slash.name: Whirling Slash
status.agi_down.desc: Decreases agility by 25% for 3 turns — acts later in the turn.
status.agi_down.name: AGI Down
status.agi_up.desc: Increases agility by 25% for 3 turns — acts earlier in the turn.
status.agi_up.name: AGI Up
status.atk_down.desc: Decreases attack power by 25% for 3 turns.
status.atk_down.name: ATK Down
status.atk_up.desc: Increases attack power by 25% for 3 turns.
status.atk_up.name: ATK Up
status.bleed.desc: Inflicts damage equal to 4% of max HP at the end of each turn for 3–4 turns.
status.bleed.name: Bleed
status.blind.desc: Reduces attack accuracy to 40% for 3–5 turns.
status.blind.name: Blind
status.charm.desc: Confuses the target into attacking random units; has a 50% chance to wear off when taking damage.
status.charm.name: Charm
status.confusion.desc: Confuses the target, causing them to attack random targets; 50% chance to break upon taking damage.
status.confusion.name: Confusion
status.curse.desc: Reduces magic attack and defense by 25% and drains 2% of max HP each turn.
status.curse.name: Curse
status.def_down.desc: Decreases physical defense by 25% for 3 turns.
status.def_down.name: DEF Down
status.def_up.desc: Increases physical defense by 25% for 3 turns.
status.def_up.name: DEF Up
status.lunatic.desc: Increases attack by 30% but lowers defense by 30% and forces attacks on random targets.
status.lunatic.name: Lunatic
status.paralysis.desc: Paralyzes the unit, preventing them from taking action for 2–3 turns.
status.paralysis.name: Paralysis
status.poison.desc: Inflicts damage equal to 5% of max HP each turn; persists after battle until cured.
status.poison.name: Poison
status.provoke.desc: Provokes the target, increasing their attack by 20% but reducing defense by 20% for 2–3 turns.
status.provoke.name: Provoke
status.regen.desc: Restores 5% of max HP at the end of each turn for 4 turns.
status.regen.name: Regen
status.silence.desc: Silences the unit, preventing skill usage for 3–5 turns.
status.silence.name: Silence
status.sleep.desc: Puts the target to sleep for 3–5 turns; waking immediately upon taking damage.
status.sleep.name: Sleep
status.spooked.desc: Reduces accuracy to 75% and lowers attack and magic defense by 15% for 2–4 turns.
status.spooked.name: Spooked
status.stun.desc: Stuns the target, preventing any action for 1–2 turns.
status.stun.name: Stun
